title: Téo, customer-service agent
summary: Text customer-service agent for a fictional instrument store: an LLM with function calling over deterministic tools, with BM25 for the store policies.

cover.alt: Cover of the Téo customer-service agent project

features: Answers about the catalog (price, promotions and stock), orders and store policies
Structured tools over CSVs and BM25 search over the policy manual
Plain Python for what must be exact: money, dates, hours and identity
Politely refuses anything out of scope
62 automated tests that run without an API key
